blocks.heading: So Portfolio and a Second Skill Decide
rows: Diploma holder with a general reel
Hard entry
Many applicants have the same reel, and AI now speeds up basic in-between work.
Artist with one strong specialty (rigging, FX, compositing, character)
Good
Studios hire for a specific task they cannot automate yet.
Technical artist who also writes scripts and tools
Strong
Pipelines and AI tools need people who connect art and code.
Freelancer or small studio with a niche (explainers, ads, product visuals)
Good with a business layer
Clients pay for a result, and you can package the work.

blocks.heading: Beat a General Animation Path
rows: UI/UX or product design
Product teams pay for design that affects sales, and the roles are widespread. See UI/UX design as a career .
It needs research and product thinking, not only visuals.
Game design or game programming
Technical skill raises pay and lowers replaceability.
It needs coding and longer learning.
Video editing and content production for brands
Brands buy this constantly, and it ties to measurable results.
Many people offer it, so niche and results matter.
